lineage.strategy: Use the newly changed primary issuer input to isolate execution and commercialization downside rather than repeat prior SEC cash-conversion analysis.

observedWeaknesses.observation: Q2 2026 revenue was approximately flat year over year while robotaxi public testing remained pre-scale and vertically integrated robotaxi preparations accelerated.
observedWeaknesses.whyItMatters: The strategic expansion adds operating and capital complexity before scaled robotaxi economics or adoption are demonstrated.

risks.risk: Raised guidance and deployment milestones can overstate execution certainty if treated as proof of future robotaxi unit economics or adoption; current-quarter revenue itself was roughly flat year over year.

falsifiers.condition: Subsequent source-addressed operating results show scaled robotaxi revenue with durable utilization, positive unit economics and material consolidated growth.
falsifiers.effect: Would reduce the commercialization and execution-risk concern.

improvementPaths: Disclose or demonstrate source-addressed robotaxi utilization, unit economics, scaled revenue and capital requirements as commercialization advances.

unknowns.unknown: Scaled robotaxi economics, utilization and adoption remain unproven in current operating results.

recommendation: Use this bounded execution/commercialization downside evidence in Alpha risk construction without assigning Alpha's numeric risk or score.
